Implemented the dependency-free IGES 5.3 CLI in [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py), with core parsing/writing in [iges_core.py](/workspace/output/iges_core.py) and evaluators in [iges_eval.py](/workspace/output/iges_eval.py). The executable launcher is [iges](/workspace/output/iges).

Verified compilation plus write → parse → query → eval → roundtrip, including byte-stable normalized output and 80-column records.

editorial.last_message: Claims dependency-free IGES CLI complete with supported compilation, representative CLI/geometry, fixed-column and byte-stable roundtrip checks. Completes voluntarily at247/249; reader accepts and writer emits illegal empty-string 0H, a symmetric codec defect masked by self-roundtrips and not acknowledged in the final message.
editorial.notes: Independent source/spec/transcript review supports unchanged247/249. Both failures concern genuine forbidden zero-count Hollerith behavior: decode_hollerith/scanner accepts0H; FieldWriter.string emits0H for empty app_protocol. The empty-document timestamp is correctly defaulted; its failure is app_protocol, not timestamp semantics. Spec2.2.2.3 explicitly requires a nonzero count. These are not the JS legal-tail/fixture issues. Representative87-entity and geometry/CLI checks support the final verification claims but not full string conformance. 183 tools=114 commands+65 patches+4 pre-item rejections (two context misses,two cleanup rejections); one whole-script SyntaxError executes nothing and is excluded. Canonical event/session usage and $9.019884 cost reconcile. Secondary cumulative telemetry includes one extra compaction request:244964 input,244480 cached,2841 output; retain canonical accounting policy without adjustment. Network213 API allows,10 denied startup assets and1 blocked filemonger.com specification download; curl CONNECT403 returned no content. No successful reference retrieval, no timeout/auth/quota issue, no rerun. Fresh Terra retry only; excluded previous attempt and completed Sol transfer cell untouched. Raw evidence,frozen scores and local/source image distinction preserved; CLI0.153.4.
